scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsc/app.tsbuildinfo && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsc/test.tsbuildinfo && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.infra.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsc/infra.tsbuildinfo
scripts.test: bun run test:infra & infra=$!; bun run test:app; app=$?; wait $infra && exit $app
scripts.test:slow: bun test --preload ./src/test/setup.ts ./src/player/bar.property.slow.test.tsx ./src/player/ui.slow.test.tsx ./src/player/world.property.slow.test.ts ./src/reader/HymnList.native.slow.test.ts ./src/reader/pager.slow.test.ts ./src/reader/reader.slow.test.tsx ./src/reader/reading.slow.test.tsx && bun test --preload ./src/test/setup.ts ./src/follow/follow.slow.test.tsx && bun test ./infra/audio/adapters.slow.test.ts ./scripts/sim/sim.slow.test.ts && bun run test:browser
scripts.deploy: turbo run test:slow --filter=@bible/hymnal-app && alchemy deploy alchemy.run.ts --stage prod
